column1: # Each kernel crate's seconds in a release suite part, building and running its own tests (its
# library's unit tests, binaries and test targets) with overflow checks and debug assertions on, on
# the slowest native leg, macOS x86-64 (four threads). First measured as its test units' build
# seconds from a cargo `--timings` report of the whole release suite on a development machine
# (four threads; 26.4 minutes there against the runner's 33.6), times 1.27, plus its tests' run
# seconds summed from the two release suite parts of main's push run 44000736713 on 79dd48d74, the
# sum over four threads; then each share's crates scaled by what that share's part took on macOS
# x86-64 against what it was planned at, in the runs by hand 44025893276 and then 44031862090 (a
# part's build and test minutes less 220 seconds for the libraries every part builds; the set-up
# is not counted). In 44031862090 share 8's part ran on a runner about twice as slow as the
# others (its first libraries took two to three times as long to reach as on the other parts), so
# its crates keep their earlier seconds. At least 1. The libraries and the set-up are the same in
# every part and are not counted. `geom_test::test_scope::Selection::parts` balances `kernel.yml`'s
# release suite shares by them (`kernel-quality test-scope --parts`); a crate not listed is planned
# at the slowest listed time. geom-num, geom-test, geom-bench, geom-format and geom-fuzz have parts
# of their own (`--apart`), so their rows balance nothing.
